description: Common envelope for the DASH-0a dashboard consolidation fixtures. `kind` pins the algorithm to dashboard-tab-plan. `expected` encodes the totality guarantee (every current TabId folded onto exactly one surface), the no-collision/no-dropped-source guarantee, and the flag-off inertness guarantee (plan module never imported, shell byte-identical).
title: DASH-0a dashboard consolidation tab-plan fixture envelope
